title: Intercom chat widget
detail: The script embed must be re-added; its behaviour is not recreated.

title: Tawk.to chat widget
detail: The script embed must be re-added; its behaviour is not recreated.

title: Crisp chat widget
detail: The script embed must be re-added; its behaviour is not recreated.

title: Drift chat widget
detail: The script embed must be re-added; its behaviour is not recreated.

title: HubSpot scripts (chat / forms / tracking)
detail: Re-add the HubSpot embed code; forms and chat keep running on HubSpot.

title: Zendesk widget
detail: The script embed must be re-added; its behaviour is not recreated.

title: WhatsApp chat button
detail: The link/widget is recreated as a plain link; any third-party widget logic is not.

title: Google Maps embed
detail: The map iframe is kept as an embed; custom map logic or API keys must be configured manually.

title: Booking / scheduling widget
detail: The booking provider embed must be re-added and reconnected to your account.

title: Payment buttons
detail: Payment provider buttons need your own keys and server-side verification.

title: Site search service
detail: Hosted search (Algolia and similar) needs its index and keys configured manually.

title: reCAPTCHA / hCaptcha
detail: Captcha keys are domain-bound and must be re-issued for the new site.

title: Cart / checkout flow
detail: Cart and checkout need a real commerce backend; they are never simulated.
